args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Update `splitFields` in `src/ingest/parser.ts` so that unquoted fields containing inch marks or quote characters do not incorrectly trigger quote mode. A quote character should only start a quoted field if it immediately follows a comma or the beginning of the line/row.
args.title: Fix CSV parser handling of unquoted fields containing quote marks
